title: Asset Integrity Mgr / Operations Director
text:
Asset Integrity Manager / Operations Director

**Sigma Oil Solutions LLC** is seeking an experienced Asset Integrity Manager / Operations Director to lead and grow our Mechanical Integrity division. This leadership role combines technical oversight, operational management, and business development within the petrochemical, refining, and oil & gas industries.Key Responsibilities

* Lead API 510, 570, and 653 inspection programs
* Oversee daily field operations and project execution
* Develop and maintain inspection procedures, forms, and quality systems
* Review and approve inspection reports and technical recommendations
* Support business development, client relationships, and proposal generation
* Recruit, mentor, and manage inspection personnel

Qualifications

* Current API 510, API 570, and API 653 certifications required
* 8+ years of fixed-equipment inspection experience
* Strong leadership, project management, and client-facing experience
* Knowledge of API, ASME, and OSHA PSM requirements
* Experience in refining, petrochemical, or downstream oil & gas preferred

Location: Friendswood, TX (Houston Area)Benefits

* Competitive salary
* Performance-based bonus program
* Medical, Dental, and Vision insurance
* Career growth and leadership advancement opportunitie

\*Email Resumes to Rick.Graves@sigmandtsolutions.com\* Competitive Pay offered based on experience\*

Pay: From $50.00 per hour

Expected hours: No less than 40.0 per week

Work Location: In person
